title: EgoLink ego-state API view v0.1
description: Versioned read-only view returned inside existing ego_state/timeline response wrappers and collection summary.latest_ego_state. Replaces the old flat object that incorrectly claimed estimation.v0.1. Consumers must use state for canonical decisions; evidence_summary is unverified source telemetry, not the full evidence-chain contract. confidence is a deterministic rule score, never measured accuracy. Legacy DEVICE frames with none of the six state identity/time members inherit estimation_id from observation_id and other identity/source-time fields from the observed collection envelope, visibly marked legacy_derived_from_collection_envelope. Partially supplied or mismatched identity, invalid enums/values and ready=false states are not valid projections. Raw collection persistence and ACK are unchanged; collection preview.ego_state_projection exposes absent/unavailable/invalid/valid diagnostics. Existing stored rows are revalidated on reads, skipped before applying the valid-result limit, and never rewritten. Source timestamps are never replaced with receipt time. Storage flags describe the current Message Hub implementation, not a Local-First or retention promise.

evidence_summary.description: Optional raw DEVICE evidence summary, outside the canonical estimation contract. Its digest is reported, not independently verified or authenticated by this view.

digest_verification.description: The device reports this digest. The API has not recomputed or authenticated the complete evidence chain and has not verified a signature.
